text:
Alex Chen: Quick stocktake — EU-west pool: how many H100 slots left for the sprint? Need to lock for H100-heavy experiments. pinging @Sanjay Kapoor and @Priya Patel
Sanjay Kapoor: Last I saw ~6 free slots, 3 on hold for training. I'll check quota + vendor ETA and report back.
Priya Patel: Procurement update: vendor says 8 units inbound but delivery window is Tue-Fri next week. Still waiting on serial numbers and ship docs.
Elaine Rivera: Can we shift some low-priority jobs to spot in us-east to free up 2 H100s? Quick win for the sprint.
inventory-bot: EU-west H100 snapshot -> free: 6, reserved: 3, pending_delivery: 2 (tracking CN12345 pending), last_update: 5m ago.
Alex Chen: thanks. Can someone paste the terraform var we should use to reserve? I remember a `reserve_count` var.
Sanjay Kapoor: Use this snippet for the reserve:```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "sprint" {
  region   = "eu-west1"
  gpu_type = "h100"
  reserved = 4
}
``` I'll open a PR tonight.
Priya Patel: FYI vendor asked for commitment by EOD Mon to hit Tue shipping. If we miss that, lead time slides.
Elaine Rivera: @Sanjay can you include a fallback policy that drops to L40s in-region? Want to avoid cross-region latency for the canary.
Sanjay Kapoor: Yep adding `fallback_model_lane = \"l40s\"` and autoscale min/max. Plan to set autoscale = { min = 1, max = 8 }.
Alex Chen: also need SRE to watch the scaling window — @Tom Brooks can you take the canary monitor next week?
Tom Brooks: Sure. I'll add a simple smoke test and dashboard. Quick test command: `curl -sS https://canary.redwood/probe | jq .latency`
VendorOps: Vendor update pushed: shipping label created, carrier CN, tracking CN12345, ETA to rack Tue 14:00 UTC (subject to customs).
Priya Patel: Thanks — I'll confirm customs brokerage ETA and serial numbers by EOD.
Elaine Rivera: Quick infra question — when reserved capacity increases, does routing auto-start to the new pool or do we need a manual rollout?
Sanjay Kapoor: Routing will auto-add the pool once instances are `ready`, but rollout rules are manual. I'll add a canary route rule so traffic only shifts after smoke passes.
Alex Chen: TL;DR action items: 1) Sanjay open TF PR to reserve 4 H100s + fallback + autoscale 2) Priya confirm vendor ETA & serials 3) Tom add smoke test + grafana alert 4) Elaine shift low-priority jobs to spot us-east 5) Alex notify product about capacity window.
Tom Brooks: Setting Grafana alert: `alert if gpu_pool.ready < 4 for 5m` for next 72h. Will post dashboard link once live.
Sanjay Kapoor: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842 (WIP). PTAL @Alex @Elaine.
Alex Chen: Looking now.
Elaine Rivera: Shifted 2 dev jobs to spot this morning, freed ~1.5 GPU equivalent. Will follow up tomorrow with final numbers.
Alex Chen: Awesome. If vendor confirms by EOD we'll merge and schedule deploy Tue AM. :thumbsup:
